expected_root_cause: A bounded in-container process allocated and touched a large block of memory in order-service.
expected_symptoms: Container memory working set increases sharply.
Order-service remains available while operating with a substantially larger working set.
Request latency may increase under host memory pressure.
expected_evidence: cAdvisor container_memory_working_set_bytes rises by approximately the configured allocation for order-service.
Prometheus retains the elevated working-set plateau throughout the incident.
Application request telemetry continues during the allocation.
Docker process inspection shows the temporary memory allocation process.
expected_resolution: Terminate the injected allocation process so memory is released; restart order-service only if it was OOM-killed, then verify memory and latency recover.

timeline.event: Capture normal order-service memory usage and request latency.
Start the bounded memory allocation in order-service.
Memory working set rises and request latency may increase or the container may be OOM-killed.
Release the allocation and confirm memory and service health recover.
